title: A lanthanide(III) dodecanuclear structure with a acylhydrazone Schiff-base ligand: slow magnetic relaxation and magnetocaloric effects

material_class.structural_family: Ln12 cubane-centered cluster with [Ln4(μ3-O)4] and [Ln3(μ3-O)(μ2-O)3] units

synthesis.procedure: 0.5 mmol Dy(CH3COO)3·6H2O (215 mg) and 0.5 mmol H4L1 (210 mg) were placed in a 15 mL polytetrafluoroethylene reactor. 6 mL CH3OH and 3 mL CH3CN were added to dissolve the reactants. After stirring for 30 min, 80 μL triethylamine (Et3N) was added. The reactor was heated at 80 °C for 72 h. After the reaction was terminated, yellow rod-like crystals of 1 were obtained.
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Yellow rod-like crystals obtained after cooling/termination of the solvothermal reaction.

properties.summary: Complex 1 is a Dy12 cluster showing weak SMM-like slow magnetic relaxation. χMT at 300 K is 169.62 cm3 K mol−1 (1000 Oe), decreasing to 95.60 cm3 K mol−1 at 2 K. M vs H/T data at 2–5 K (0–5 T) do not superimpose, indicating magnetic anisotropy. Weak out-of-phase ac susceptibility is observed at zero dc field (9–999 Hz); Arrhenius/Cole–Cole analysis gives Ueff = 2.9–5.7 K and τ0 = 9.2×10−4 to 3.5×10−5 s.

measurements.name: Ueff
measurements.conditions: ac susceptibility, 0 Oe dc field; Cole–Cole/Arrhenius analysis (Fig. S4)

measurements.name: τ0
measurements.conditions: ac susceptibility, 0 Oe dc field (Fig. S4)

material_class.structural_family: Ln12 cubane-centered cluster with [Ln4(μ3-O)4] and [Ln3(μ3-O)(μ2-O)3] units

synthesis.procedure: Prepared analogously to complex 1, replacing the metal salt with Gd(CH3COO)3·6H2O (215 mg). The same solvothermal procedure (H4L1, MeOH/MeCN, Et3N, 80 °C, 72 h in a PTFE reactor) afforded yellow crystals of 2.

reagents.name: 2,6-bis(2-((E)-2-hydroxybenzylidene)hydrazine-1-carbonyl)pyridine 1-oxide
reagents.amount: 0.5 mmol (210 mg) as in the procedure for 1

reagents.name: triethylamine
reagents.amount: 80 μL as in the procedure for 1

synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Yellow crystals obtained after the solvothermal reaction.

properties.summary: Complex 2 is a Gd12 cluster with a large magnetocaloric effect. χMT at 300 K is 92.61 cm3 K mol−1 (1000 Oe). Magnetization reaches 74.41 NμB at 2 K (vs theoretical 80 NμB). −ΔSm = 32.49 J kg−1 K−1 at 2 K for ΔH = 5 T (Maxwell relation from M(T,H)), below the 41.6 J kg−1 K−1 value calculated for twelve isolated Gd(III) S = 7/2 spins, attributed to weak antiferromagnetic interactions.

measurements.name: −ΔSm
measurements.conditions: 2 K, ΔH = 5 T; from magnetization data via Maxwell equation (Fig. 4b; reported in text as −ΔSm of the Gd12 complex)

source_locations.location: SADVUS/2034885 matched to Gd12; paper lists 2009675 for 2
